Subject: Re: Test-Harness-Straps (was Re: 5.10 code freeze and dual-life modules)

----- Original Message ----
> From: Andy Lester 

> > On 16 Nov 2007, at 17:32, Andy Lester wrote:
> >> T:H:Straps on the CPAN is for use with T:H 3.0, not T:H 2.x
> >
> >
> > Heh. I didn't know that :)
> 
> Is that NOT the case?  My understanding is that it was for  
> compatibility with T::H 3.

Er, maybe if you squint :)

This is a stopgap measure so that people upgrading to TH3 but rely on Straps don't have their code suddenly break.  Straps will no longer be maintained and people are encouraged to make use of the new TH rather than try to build more things on top of Straps.  It has no relation to TH3.

Further, it's my understanding that it's merely borrewed from the old Test::Harness (on whose internals it surprisingly does not rely).  If the old Test::Harness is shipped with 5.10, Straps will be in there.


Cheers,
Ovid
